title: K_0 class of a finite projective module with a finite free resolution
statement: Let $S$ be a commutative ring and let $L$ be a finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module] $S$-module. Suppose there are an integer $d\ge0$, integers $r_0,\dots,r_d\ge0$ and an exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] of $S$-modules $0\to F_d\to\cdots\to F_1\to F_0\to L\to 0$ in which each $F_i$ is free [def-weil-pbc-free-module] with a basis of $r_i$ elements. Then $[L]=n[S]$ in $K_0(S)$ [def-trf-k0-group] for the integer $n=\sum_{i=0}^d(-1)^ir_i$; in particular $[L]=n[S]$ for some $n\in\mathbf Z$.
